_doc: Typical portions for common generic foods. 'match' = case-insensitive regexes tested against the German and English food name (first matching rule wins, so specific rules come first). 'g' = grams; 'ml' = millilitres (converted with the food density when the food is stored per 100 g). 'default' marks the most common portion (initial slider position).

match: ^(Quinoa, roh|Amaranth, Samen, roh|Hirse, Korn|Buchweizen, Korn|Rollgerste|Maisgriess, trocken|Hartweizengriess)
